title: 第4章 来源第5章 下载一
slug: 无限魔神没流量怎么下载
content_zh:
在他的视网膜之上，此刻赫然浮现了一行字迹。
【源值+0.01缕】
见此一幕。
他心中一动。
唤出太素面板。
【机主：胡隆】
【技能：网络攻防（大师）】
【网速：8MS】
【流量：0M】
【源值：3.01缕】
这一道虚幻银白下载面板再度浮现在眼前，只不过，相比之前发生了一些变化。
最下方的源值一栏此刻变成3.01缕。
相比之前，凭空增长了0.01。
“这源值的来源是什么？”
胡隆目光微微动了动。
扫视着空荡的四周。
旋即像是想到了什么，视线看向窗外。
“难不成是……”
他心中升起一个猜测，不过这个还需要进行验证才可。
胡隆继续躺在床上，一动不动，像是睡着了一般。

时间流逝。
几只灰色麻雀落在窗外的树枝头上，发出叽叽喳喳的声音。
照进屋内的光线也随着时间的流逝出现一些偏移。
而原本躺着的胡隆忽然再次睁开了眼睛。
【源值+0.01缕】
一行银白色的字迹浮现，随后缓缓淡化下去。
同时，面板之上的源值一栏再度增长了0.01。
见此一幕。
他勉强支撑身躯，来到床角一侧的阴影里。
等待了差不多同样的时间，并没有发生什么变化。
“果然如此！”
胡隆心中微动，眼中闪过一丝明了。
此时此刻，他已经差不多可以确认，这源值的来源或许就是因为阳光。
他能够从阳光之中汲取面板需要的源值。
当然，是否真是如此，还需要进行多次验证看看再说。
时间无声淌过，正午炽烈的日轮已悄然西沉。
天边铺开大片大片的火红晚霞，像泼翻的熔金，将半边苍穹烧得滚烫。
病房里的明亮被暮色吞没。
阴影从墙角、床底后缓缓爬出，一寸寸蚕食着病房内的空间。
唯有窗边残留着一线微弱的天光，昏黄地照在地板上，如同即将燃尽的余烬。

咔哒。
门板下方的小铁窗被从外侧拉开。
“吃饭了！”
content_en:
On his retina, a line of writing suddenly appeared.
[Source value +0.01 wisp]
See this scene.
Something moved in his heart.
Call out the Taisu panel.
[Owner: Hu Long]
[Skill: Network Attack and Defense (Master)]
[Internet speed: 8MS]
【Traffic: 0M】
[Source value: 3.01 rays]
This illusory silver-white download panel appeared in front of me again, but there were some changes compared to before.
The source value column at the bottom now becomes 3.01.
Compared with before, it increased by 0.01 out of thin air.
"What is the source of this source value?"
Hu Long's eyes moved slightly.
Scanning the empty surroundings.
Immediately he seemed to think of something and looked out the window.
"Could it be..."
A guess arose in his mind, but this still needs to be verified.
Hu Long continued to lie on the bed, motionless, as if he was asleep.
Time passes.
A few gray sparrows landed on the branches outside the window and made a chirping sound.
The light that shines into the house also shifts somewhat as time goes by.
Hu Long, who was originally lying down, suddenly opened his eyes again.
[Source value +0.01 wisp]
A line of silver-white handwriting appeared, and then slowly faded away.
At the same time, the source value column above the panel increased by 0.01 again.
See this scene.
He barely supported his body and came to the shadow on the corner of the bed.
After waiting for about the same amount of time, nothing changed.
"As expected!"
Hu Long's heart moved slightly, and a glimmer of understanding flashed in his eyes.
At this moment, he can almost confirm that the source of this source value may be due to sunlight.
He can draw the source value the panel needs from sunlight.
Of course, whether this is really the case requires multiple verifications.
Time passed by silently, and the blazing sun at noon had quietly set in the west.
Large expanses of fiery red sunset spread across the sky, like spilled molten gold, burning half of the sky.
The brightness in the ward was swallowed up by dusk.
Shadows slowly crawled out from the corners and under the bed, encroaching on the space in the ward inch by inch.
Only a faint ray of skylight remained by the window, shining dimly on the floor like an ember that was about to burn out.
Click.
The small iron window under the door panel was pulled open from the outside.
"It's time to eat!"
